result.summary: The page looks generally functional with no critical visual defects. One minor truncation issue was found in the restaurant listing.

issues.description: The restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol...' in the 'Fastest near you' carousel is truncated without an ellipsis indicator, making it unclear that text is cut off.
issues.suggestion: Apply CSS text-overflow: ellipsis or ensure the card width accommodates the full restaurant name, or use a consistent truncation style with '...' to signal the text continues.
